metadata.source: PSOC - Suspicious Windows Defender Folder Exclusion Added Via Reg.EXE.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Suspicious Windows Defender Folder Exclusion Added Via Reg.EXE
properties.description: Detects the use of reg.exe to exclude folders from AV
properties.query:
//Detects the use of reg.exe to exclude folders from AV
let cmd_any = dynamic(["SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions\\Paths","SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft Antimalware\\Exclusions\\Paths"]);
let cmd_all = dynamic(["add","/t","REG_DWORD","/v","/d","0"]);
_Im_ProcessCreate(commandline_has_any=cmd_any,commandline_has_all=cmd_all,targetprocess_has_any="reg.exe")
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
